criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a new test feeds a result event whose top-level usage differs from modelUsage (a main thread plus subagent usage on the requested model). It shows the resulting invocation record passes check_invocation with no Reconciliation violation.
criteria.evidence: stream::tests::invocation_tokens_are_the_sum_of_model_usage_not_the_top_level_usage feeds the 2fsa-shaped result event, but it only asserts that ResultEvent.usage equals the modelUsage figures. It never builds an Invocation or calls check_invocation. reconcile::tests::job_2fsa_figures_disagree_but_the_all_model_sum_reconciles calls check_invocation, but on an Invocation whose tokens are set by hand rather than produced from a result event. Both tests pass. No single test runs from the event to the record to check_invocation, and the step in invocation.rs that maps output.usage to the record's tokens is not exercised for this shape.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a reconcile test shows that an invocation whose measured tokens genuinely disagree with its per-model usage is still flagged.
criteria.evidence: job_2fsa_figures_disagree_but_the_all_model_sum_reconciles asserts one violation for tokens 6/3136/275219/3821 against modelUsage 90/52656/3634696/134508. usage_split_over_several_models_is_summed and requested_model_tokens_must_match also assert one violation. All 6 reconcile tests passed.

criteria.criterion: The invocation's measured tokens and the gate's check use one definition. The definition is stated in a doc comment: either the sum of modelUsage over all models or the requested model's modelUsage. The gate compares like with like.
criteria.evidence: The module doc comment in reconcile.rs (//!) states that the per-model tokens, summed over all models, equal the measured tokens, and that the driver records the same sum. parse_result in stream.rs sums models_used into usage. check_invocation sums models_used.values() and compares the result with inv.tokens. In stream.rs the definition is a plain // comment, not a doc comment.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check: both are clean. Existing stream and claude tests still pass.
criteria.evidence: Clippy finished with no warnings and fmt printed nothing. athena-agent: 37 passed, 1 ignored. athena-gate: 74 passed.

criteria.criterion: The defect's numbers (90/52656/3634696/134508 against 6/3136/275219/3821) appear in a regression test fixture or comment, so the owner can see the job 2fsa failure is covered.
criteria.evidence: Both figure sets appear in the stream.rs test's JSON fixture and comment, and in the reconcile.rs test's comment and values.

findings.summary: No test runs a result event through to the invocation record and check_invocation, as criterion 1 requires.
findings.evidence: The stream test stops at ResultEvent.usage. The reconcile test builds Invocation.tokens by hand. invocation.rs line 209, where tokens enter the record, is not exercised for a result event whose top-level usage differs from modelUsage. landing_tests.rs, claude.rs and fake.rs were listed as deliverables but not changed, so there is no test through the claude driver's fake script or the gate's landing tests.

findings.summary: Older records that used more than one model may now fail check_records. Not checked: the snapshot has no records/.
findings.evidence: check_records runs check_invocation on every invocation record. Records written before this change compared their tokens with the requested model's entry only. Any of them with extra models in models_used would now differ from the all-model sum. This depends on records/, which is absent from the snapshot.

findings.summary: In stream.rs the one-definition statement is a // comment, not a doc comment on ResultEvent.usage or the AgentOutput.usage field.
findings.evidence: The doc on AgentOutput.usage in lib.rs:96 still reads 'Final usage when usage_measured' and does not name the modelUsage sum.

summary: The fix is right but criterion 1 is not met. When a result event reports `modelUsage`, stream.rs now sets the invocation's tokens to its sum over all models, with the top-level `usage` only as the fallback. The gate in reconcile.rs now compares the recorded tokens with that same sum. The change also carries the job 2fsa figures, a CHANGELOG entry naming the root cause, and clean clippy and fmt. Criterion 1 asks for a test that feeds a result event shaped like job 2fsa's and shows the resulting invocation record passing check_invocation. The change instead adds two separate halves. The stream test checks only the parsed usage. The reconcile test checks an invocation built by hand. The step in invocation.rs that turns the parsed usage into the record is never run on this shape. None of landing_tests.rs, claude.rs, fake.rs or invocation.rs was touched, though the brief listed them as deliverables. Unverified risk: records written before this change that used more than one model may now fail check_records. The snapshot has no records/ to check this.
